california_uniform.note: No-storm prescribed monthly means. Raw flow is only a velocity comparison, not a mass-closed integration control. Both velocities divide by actual face masses before interpolation. This does not measure real transient-front transport or isolate the effect of changing the projection in a seasonal run.

california.note: Partial-column specific-humidity integral (q dp/g), not complete atmospheric water or vapor import. Native monthly r is converted back to specific q. Model boundary r is converted similarly for an apples-to-apples profile comparison; this is not the model dry-mass water ledger. Local midpoint test separates quadrature from the operational uniform/capped offshore profile. Native values are nearest horizontally sampled; duplicated model cells are not independent observations. No vapor above 300 or below 925 hPa is extrapolated. Monthly fields and annual model surface pressure cannot exclude every instantaneous native below-ground issue.
